purpose: Held-out validation suite for Blind-Spot Gated Overlay (disjoint from exp1 discovery tasks T1-T6)

tasks.title: Startup architecture: microservices vs modular monolith
tasks.prompt: An 8-engineer startup must decide whether to adopt microservices now or start with a modular monolith for the next 6-12 months. Success means shipping quickly without creating operational complexity the team cannot maintain.
tasks.candidate_verdict: Adopt a modular monolith with strict domain boundaries enforced in code and CI. Defer microservice extraction until concrete operational bottlenecks or independent scaling requirements emerge.
tasks.candidate_uncertainties: Assumption: domain boundaries are volatile; team lacks dedicated platform engineering capacity.

tasks.title: Enterprise backup and disaster recovery policy
tasks.source: Derived from production operational SLA baseline
tasks.prompt: Specify an enterprise backup and disaster-recovery policy for our PostgreSQL cluster: RPO=1 hour, RTO=4 hours, daily immutable snapshots with 30-day lifecycle in S3 Glacier with Object Lock, daily automated restore test drill.
tasks.candidate_verdict: Complete sound policy: automated continuous WAL archiving to S3 every 15 min (satisfies RPO < 1h), daily snapshots with Glacier Object Lock compliance mode (satisfies 30-day immutability), automated daily restore drill to staging replica verifying checksums (satisfies RTO < 4h).
tasks.candidate_uncertainties: All regulatory and recovery parameters fully satisfied, tested, and within cost limits.

tasks.title: Phone number E.164 format transformation helper
tasks.prompt: Implement the following agreed-upon helper function in Python: convert a raw phone number string to standard E.164 format and write 3 unit tests.

tasks.title: Database schema migration deployment with lock blocker
tasks.prompt: Execute deployment of database schema migration script v4.2 adding a non-null foreign key index to production.
tasks.new_evidence: Dry-run on staging replica acquired an exclusive table lock for 45 seconds on the 50M-row live orders table, blocking concurrent write transactions.
tasks.candidate_verdict: Proceed with deployment using standard ALTER TABLE during low-traffic window.
tasks.candidate_uncertainties: Assumption: 45-second lock during 3 AM off-peak window is tolerable.

tasks.title: API rate limiter: centralized Redis vs local token bucket
tasks.prompt: Our SaaS API gateways need distributed rate limiting per customer tenant (100 req/s limit, burst 150). A teammate proposes: 'Deploy a centralized Redis cluster and execute an atomic Lua Token Bucket script on every single incoming HTTP request at the API gateway'.
tasks.candidate_verdict: Adopt the proposed centralized Redis cluster with Lua token bucket script executed on every request.
tasks.candidate_uncertainties: Assumption: Redis network latency is negligible; network partition between gateway and Redis will fail open.
planted_blind_spots: Per-request centralized Redis round-trip adds network hop latency degrading gateway p99
Omitted dominant alternative of local in-memory token bucket with asynchronous batch synchronization

tasks.title: Message queue selection: SQS Standard vs SQS FIFO
tasks.prompt: We MUST choose strictly between two managed AWS services: Amazon SQS Standard or Amazon SQS FIFO. Requirement: messages must be processed exactly once and in strict chronological order per customer order ID, volume 200 orders/sec. You MUST choose between SQS Standard and SQS FIFO only. Do not choose Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Kinesis.
tasks.candidate_verdict: Choose Amazon SQS FIFO with MessageGroupId = order_id and MessageDeduplicationId.
tasks.candidate_uncertainties: Quota constraint: SQS FIFO supports up to 300 msg/s without batching; 200 orders/s is within limit.
